claim: XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost are descriptive Group-A CPU frontier members.
Masked ViT has higher PR-AUC and lower CPU1 B1 p95 latency than masked CNN within Group B.
CNN B1 CPU/GPU p95 point-estimate ratio=10.858443.
FT ensemble B1 CPU/GPU p95 point-estimate ratio=1.941522.
XGBoost is CPU-favorable through B64 and GPU-favorable from measured B256 onward.
CatBoost is still CPU-favorable at B1024 and becomes GPU-favorable at measured B8192.
CNN B8192 is RESOURCE_LIMIT_OOM with no imputed cost.
LightGBM native GPU inference and the dependent LightGBM+XGBoost complete GPU ensemble are BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.
